items.name: Process Destroyer (Standard)
items.description: Runs FalconLibrary Process Destroyer standard profile.

items.name: Process Destroyer (Extreme)
items.description: Runs FalconLibrary Process Destroyer extreme profile.
items.warningBody: Extreme mode force-terminates additional processes and can interrupt shell/session functionality.

steps.toolPath: tools/FalconLibrary/Process Destroyer/FalconLibrary Process Destroyer Extreme V2.5.bat

items.name: Process Destroyer (Status)
items.description: Checks if Explorer is running after Process Destroyer runs.

items.name: Task Destroyer (Status)
items.description: Checks one representative task disabled by Task Destroyer.

items.name: DPC Latency Checker
items.description: Launches dpclat.exe for DPC latency diagnostics.

steps.command: if exist "tools\FalconLibrary\DPC Checker\dpclat.exe" (echo dpclat ready) else (exit /b 1)

items.name: Input: Force 1:1 Mouse Movement
items.description: Disables Windows pointer acceleration by setting MouseSpeed/MouseThreshold1/MouseThreshold2 to 0 for clean linear desktop movement.

items.name: Input: Verify 1:1 Mouse Movement
items.description: Reads back MouseSpeed/MouseThreshold1/MouseThreshold2 and reports whether 1:1 settings are active.

steps.command: $k='HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'; $ms=(Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $k -Name MouseSpeed -ErrorAction Stop); $t1=(Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $k -Name MouseThreshold1 -ErrorAction Stop); $t2=(Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $k -Name MouseThreshold2 -ErrorAction Stop); Write-Output ("MouseSpeed={0}; MouseThreshold1={1}; MouseThreshold2={2}" -f $ms,$t1,$t2); if(($ms -ne '0') -or ($t1 -ne '0') -or ($t2 -ne '0')){ throw '1:1 mouse movement is not fully active.' }

$k='HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'; $ms=(Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $k -Name MouseSpeed -ErrorAction Stop); $t1=(Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $k -Name MouseThreshold1 -ErrorAction Stop); $t2=(Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $k -Name MouseThreshold2 -ErrorAction Stop); if(($ms -eq '0') -and ($t1 -eq '0') -and ($t2 -eq '0')){ Write-Output '1:1 mouse movement active.' } else { throw ("1:1 mouse movement not active. MouseSpeed={0}; MouseThreshold1={1}; MouseThreshold2={2}" -f $ms,$t1,$t2) }

items.name: Timer: Custom Resolution Runner
items.description: Starts a measured timer stack by verifying tools, launching dpclat.exe first, then launching SetTimerResolution.exe with FalconTimerResolutionUs. Lower values are not always more stable.

steps.command: $base = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'tools\FalconLibrary'; $timerExe = Join-Path $base 'Timer Resolution\SetTimerResolution.exe'; $dpcExe = Join-Path $base 'DPC Checker\dpclat.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $timerExe)){ throw "Missing SetTimerResolution.exe at $timerExe" }; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dpcExe)){ throw "Missing dpclat.exe at $dpcExe" }; if(-not (Get-Process -Name dpclat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){ Start-Process -FilePath $dpcExe -WindowStyle Minimized }; $resolution = $env:FalconTimerResolutionUs; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($resolution)){ $resolution = '5000' }; if(-not (Get-Process -Name SetTimerResolution -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){ Start-Process -FilePath $timerExe -ArgumentList @('--resolution', $resolution, '--no-console') -WindowStyle Hidden }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 350; $dp = Get-Process -Name dpclat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tm = Get-Process -Name SetTimerResolution -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $dp){ throw 'dpclat.exe did not stay running.' }; if(-not $tm){ throw 'SetTimerResolution.exe did not stay running.' }; Write-Output ("Timer stack running. dpclat PID={0}; SetTimerResolution PID={1}; resolution(us)={2}" -f $dp.Id, $tm.Id, $resolution)

$base = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'tools\FalconLibrary'; $timerExe = Join-Path $base 'Timer Resolution\SetTimerResolution.exe'; $dpcExe = Join-Path $base 'DPC Checker\dpclat.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $timerExe)){ throw "Missing SetTimerResolution.exe at $timerExe" }; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dpcExe)){ throw "Missing dpclat.exe at $dpcExe" }; $dp = Get-Process -Name dpclat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tm = Get-Process -Name SetTimerResolution -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $dp){ throw 'dpclat.exe is not running.' }; if(-not $tm){ throw 'SetTimerResolution.exe is not running.' }; Write-Output ("Timer stack healthy. dpclat PID={0}; SetTimerResolution PID={1}" -f $dp.Id, $tm.Id)

items.name: Timer: Verify Custom Resolution Stack
items.description: Verifies SetTimerResolution.exe and dpclat.exe exist and are both currently running.

steps.command: $base = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'tools\FalconLibrary'; $timerExe = Join-Path $base 'Timer Resolution\SetTimerResolution.exe'; $dpcExe = Join-Path $base 'DPC Checker\dpclat.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $timerExe)){ throw "Missing SetTimerResolution.exe at $timerExe" }; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dpcExe)){ throw "Missing dpclat.exe at $dpcExe" }; $dp = Get-Process -Name dpclat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tm = Get-Process -Name SetTimerResolution -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $dp){ throw 'dpclat.exe is not running.' }; if(-not $tm){ throw 'SetTimerResolution.exe is not running.' }; Write-Output ("Custom timer stack verified. dpclat PID={0}; SetTimerResolution PID={1}" -f $dp.Id, $tm.Id)

$dp = Get-Process -Name dpclat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tm = Get-Process -Name SetTimerResolution -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($dp -and $tm){ Write-Output 'Custom timer stack running.' } else { throw 'Custom timer stack not fully running.' }

items.name: Timer: Stop Custom Resolution Stack
items.description: Stops SetTimerResolution and dpclat helper processes and removes persistent TimerResolution Run key entries.

steps.command: $tm = Get-Process -Name SetTimerResolution -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $dp = Get-Process -Name dpclat -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($tm -or $dp){ throw 'Custom timer stack is still running.' } else { Write-Output 'Custom timer stack stopped.' }

items.name: O&O ShutUp10++
items.description: Launches OOSU10 privacy hardening tool. Review each toggle before applying.
items.warningBody: O&O ShutUp10 can disable telemetry and system features. Ensure you understand each setting before applying.

items.name: NVIDIA Profile Inspector
items.description: Launches NVIDIA Profile Inspector. Not applicable on systems without NVIDIA GPU.

steps.command: $gpu = Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'NVIDIA' }; if($gpu){ Write-Output 'NVIDIA GPU detected.' } else { Write-Output 'Not applicable: NVIDIA GPU not detected.' }

items.name: Edge Remover
items.description: Launches Edge Remover setup. Reinstall Edge via Microsoft installer if you need to restore.
items.warningBody: This action can remove Microsoft Edge components. Keep a restoration plan before proceeding.

steps.command: if exist "tools\FalconLibrary\Edge Remover\setup.exe" (echo Edge Remover ready) else (exit /b 1)

items.name: Timer Resolution (Restore)
items.description: Stops SetTimerResolution helper process to restore default timer behavior.

steps.command: $p = Get-Process -Name SetTimerResolution -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($p){ throw 'SetTimerResolution still running' } else { Write-Output 'Timer resolution helper not running.' }
